description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [High Quick Cast 1]/[Weakness +15% Boost (15s)] and [High Quick Cast 1]/[Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] and [High Quick Cast 1] to the user/all allies/all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF11 allies are alive, grants [Awoken Talent], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Raging Flurry] to the user

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Awoken Talent
description.text: Lightning and Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Lightning and Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Raging Flurry
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using three Ice or Lightning abilities if the triggering ability deals Ice/Lightning damage
